# GarageAI

> Enterprise-grade private LLM proxy: secure, privacy-first access to multiple AI models for developers.

GarageAI is a two-sided marketplace for local AI capacity. Buyers use open models through an OpenAI-compatible API, while operators offer GPU capacity and earn per token.

## Links

- [Home](https://app.garageai.eu/)
- [Available models](https://app.garageai.eu/models)
- [API documentation](https://app.garageai.eu/api)
- [Sign in](https://app.garageai.eu/auth)
